title: Blast Off! Summer Showdown
description:
Dive into 10 unique and easy-to-play party games filled with summer fun!

Launch rocket fireworks at your rivals, slip and slide as somen noodles, and swipe fresh-grilled BBQ before anyone else can grab it!

Challenge CPU opponents in single-player, or battle it out with family and friends in a group of up to 4 players!

[Free Mode]

Pick your favorite game and jump right in!

[Party Mode]

Choose a series of games and play them back-to-back!

Compete for the highest total score to become the champion!

[Included Minigames]・Fire! Rocket Fireworks

Launch the rocket fireworks you've placed and destroy your rivals' sandcastles!

・Somen Slide

Race down a flowing somen noodle slide! Dodge obstacles and reach the finish line!

・Float Ring Battlers

Put on your float ring and charge into your rivals! Knock your opponent into the sea three times to win!

・Fan Blast!

Control a remote-operated fan and collect objects! Use the wind direction to your advantage!

・BBQ Grab Battle

Flip the skewers and cook them evenly! Be the first to grab perfectly grilled skewers!

・Frozen Treat Tower

Collect frozen treats and build the tallest tower! The highest tower wins!

・Beetle Battle

Become a mighty beetle! Lock horns with your rivals and send them flying!

・Trick Surfing

Ride the waves and pull off awesome tricks! Nail the perfect tube ride!

・Sandal Toss

Throw your sandals for the highest score! You can even aim for your rivals' sandals!

・Smack the Mosquitoes!

Swat the swarming mosquitoes! Go after the rainbow and golden mosquitoes for huge points!

Note: Controllers are required for local multiplayer.
description_short: Blast off and let the chaos begin! A party game for up to 4 players featuring 10 summer-themed minigames, including rocket fireworks, flowing somen races, and BBQ battles!
